name: Fossil revival
desc: Hand a fossil to the scientists working with Professor Jasmine and they send it to a laboratory on Cinnabar Island for revival. They call you back once the Pokémon is ready.

name: Show a Poké Ball Pokémon
desc: A student is writing up class notes. Show her a Pokémon that looks like a Poké Ball (Voltorb line) and she rewards you.

name: Shiny hunt
desc: A long-serving Trainer has never seen a Pokémon with unusual colouring and asks you to come back if you find one.

name: Show a Fairy-type
desc: A traveller unnerved by the forest wishes she had a Fairy-type; showing her one you are walking with prompts a reward.

name: The Moon Stone guide
desc: Dardusk is permanently dark, so residents tell day from night by the Moon Stones, which glow only at night. A townsperson gives you one to use as a guide.

name: Lustroustone in the Mines
desc: Finding a Lustroustone in the Mines impresses the Museum staff. The Director has you take the stone disk for safekeeping, because Team Steam will work out that what they stole was a replica and come back for the real one.

name: Complete the collection
desc: A collector rewards you once you have found them all.

name: The Villa
desc: An owner moving to Kanto hands over his Villa, furniture and all.

name: Coin Case and free Coins
desc: A vendor gives you a leather Coin Case, and a lucky player at the Game Corner hands over some of his winnings.

name: Show your Pokédex
desc: A scientist in the gate between the National Park and Route 410 is delighted to see a Pokédex again and gives you the Catch ’Em All medal (1 medal energy). With it on, wild Pokémon are randomly easier to catch, depending on how many Pokémon you have registered in the Pokédex.
short: A scientist is delighted to see a Pokédex and gives you the Catch ’Em All medal.

name: The lake trio
desc: Once you reach the end of this version, go back to Pantem Town: Cynthia is inside the house that used to be locked. Talking to her opens Pantem Cave, where a disk puzzle waits. Solve it to release Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf. Like the legendary dogs in HeartGold, they then roam, turning up at random on different routes; the PDA shows where each one is.
short: Free Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf from Pantem Cave once this version is done.
steps: Reach the end of this version.
Go back to Pantem Town. Cynthia is inside the house that used to be locked.
Talk to her. She grants you entry to Pantem Cave.
Solve the disk puzzle inside the cave.
Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf are released and roam, like the legendary dogs in HeartGold: each turns up at random on a different route.
Check the PDA to see where each one is.

name: Mt. Origin expedition
desc: She is organising the expedition to Mt. Origin and wants you along once it is ready.

name: The search for the Plates
desc: Agreed in Dardusk City. The map found in Central City may hold the locations of many of the Plates.

name: Find Team Steam's base
desc: He has not forgotten the mission the two of you discussed: hit Team Steam where it hurts by finding their base.
